sessions.label: The Sponge Squad team repository bootstrap
open_questions: What exact user or decision are we helping?
What is the smallest end-to-end interaction worth proving today?
Which claim needs evidence before we invest in implementation?
What can we test cheaply before converging on the final build?

decisions.text: Use the repository as shared team memory so parallel AI-assisted execution does not replace collaboration.
Separate problem framing, evidence, experiments, implementation and pitch so a polished build cannot silently substitute for validation.
Treat provenance and dataset fitness as first-class evidence; abstaining from an unsupported conclusion is a valid result.
